name: Shiroyama Saki
source: Feared by the boys. Admired by the girls. She is bossy and harsh, but is also very good-looking. Despite looking scary, she is an ally of the girls and they look up to her as an older sister. She dislikes crooked and vile things. She is admired by many men, but since her boyfriend is the boss of the a gang, they are struck silence. Dating Saki is considered the boss's medal.
